description: This file defines the BufferSliceReaderInput struct, which provides input reading capabilities for BufferSlice buffers within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It includes methods for slicing buffers, managing buffer segments, and reading data spans.

classes.name: BufferSliceReaderInput
classes.description: A struct that facilitates reading from BufferSlice buffers, supporting buffer segmentation and span-based data access.

methods.name: BufferSliceReaderInput
methods.description: Constructor initializing the BufferSliceReaderInput with a BufferSlice.

methods.name: ForkFrom
methods.description: Creates a new BufferSliceReaderInput starting from a specified position within the current buffer slice.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next span of bytes from the buffer, handling segment transitions and buffer boundaries.
